title: Billing profile per account with direct or invoiced mode, set by operators
description:
As an operator, I set how a client account is billed, so that each account has exactly one billing mode and contact.

Feature: Billing profile
  Scenario: Set a profile
    Given an account with no billing profile and an operator holding accounts:admin:billing
    When the operator sets mode direct or invoiced, currency and billing contact
    Then billing/profiles/<account>.json is created with revision 1, the creation operation id and an audit entry, and the account document is unchanged
  Scenario: Change mode
    Given a profile in invoiced mode with open billing lines
    When the operator switches to direct
    Then the switch is refused until each open line is re-homed by its own operation, and the refusal names the lines
  Scenario: Not an operator
    Given a signed-in account owner
    When they try to set the profile
    Then 403 forbidden and nothing is written
  Scenario: Replay
    Given a profile write that lost its response
    When the same operation id is sent again
    Then the same result returns and no second revision exists

Done looks like: `billing/profile.ts` with validation rules in the repository's named-predicate style, conditional writes through the Rust bridge, deterministic operation ids, revision compare-and-set; operator route `PUT /v1/account-directory/operator/accounts/{id}/billing-profile` gated by a new reviewed permission `accounts:admin:billing` in `accounts/operator-grants.json`; customer read route `GET /accounts/{id}/billing` on the portal BFF returning mode and masked contact.

Data touched: new `prospectus-central/billing/profiles/` prefix; `accounts/operator-grants.json` schema (new permission). No account document change.

Specs: `features/billing-profile.feature`; `billing/profile.test.ts` beside the module; a refusal-log test that no contact data is logged.

Needs Ryan's concrete approval before deployment: the new S3 prefix in the runtime role policy, the new permission, and the first `accounts:admin:billing` grant (operator confirms their Google profile privately, as for `accounts:admin:read`).
